title: One link that holds your whole week
body: Connect every calendar you keep, set the hours you actually work, and hand out a single address. Tempo checks all of them before it offers anybody a time.

title: Availability that belongs to the group
body: Pool a team and let bookings go round-robin by who has taken the fewest, or find the one hour four people share. Working hours can differ; the maths does not care.

title: Panels booked without a reply-all
body: Send one link to the candidate. Tempo finds the slot the whole panel shares, holds it, and writes it into every interviewer's calendar at once.

title: Callbacks the customer chooses
body: Put the booking page at the end of a ticket. The customer picks a time that suits them, and the agent's day stops being a queue of interruptions.
